notes: Axis Naval Convoy Capacity Table (SPI 56.5), jp2 178. Tonnage for the Game-Turn = fixed tons + tons_per_pip x one die, rounded up to the nearest 1,000 tons (with whole-die rolls every result is already a multiple of 500; only B and C at odd rolls round). 56.21 calls the same table the Tonnage Capacity / Tonnage Determination Table

Cross-check: transcribed from the archive.org scan (jp2 178) and cross-checked cell by cell against the 300 dpi community scan (scan:discord:Axis Charts.pdf:p36): 0 of 14 cells differ. 56.21's worked example (level E, roll 4 = 21,000 tons) also agrees
